all_findings.candidate_fix: Add a portfolio-level drawdown circuit breaker: when running DD exceeds 10% within 5 trading days, force trim each position by 50% at next close. Re-entry permitted only after equity recovers to within 5% of prior peak. Implementation point: extend tools/run_broker_position_risk_replay.py or wire into operating_main/concentrated_target_book builder.
all_findings.evidence: MDD window 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-18 (-26.03% drawdown, equity loss $33,234) had only 14 round-trip exits totaling $-1,933 P&L. The drawdown is therefore dominated by unrealized loss on still-held positions (realized share 5.8%).

all_findings.candidate_fix: Reduce capacity_for_regime['neutral'] in the operating book builder by 20-30%, or tighten entry quality threshold (e.g. raise min_score_quantile) for neutral signal dates. Re-measure F2 share on next broker-ledger replay.
all_findings.evidence: 55% of total realized losses ($-174,141 of $-314,390) occurred in neutral regime, across 256 trades (avg $-680). The engine over-allocates or over-trades in this regime.

all_findings.candidate_fix: Tighten the leader-rescue / stale-trim threshold so a position is exit-flagged earlier in its decline. Inspect tools/run_lifecycle_review_overlay.py and the stale_mega_leader_score weighting in r1000_main_v2.py.
all_findings.evidence: target_exit losers average $-721 loss over 364 trades, while target_rebalance losers average $-436 over 119 trades. Explicit exits are firing too late.

all_findings.candidate_fix: Use the emitted mdd_policy_bucket_summary.csv and mdd_target_rows.csv to design one narrow PIT-safe entry/hold sizing rule. Do not promote the bucket itself; validate any rule through broker-ledger fast replay.
all_findings.evidence: Operating target-book rows linked to MDD losers show bucket `information_technology_loss_cluster` with $-30,263 linked position P&L (41% of top context loss), 6 tickers, avg weight 6.5%, max weight 12.0%. Top tickers: AMD, NOW, FTNT, QRVO, RNG, UI.
